properties.name: Built work reads as built: a Component's built_reading, the owner's awaiting_word list, and the ship step closes the idea it answers
properties.rationale:
The finding (fact:root-cause-built-work-stays-open-because-its-record-is-kept-by-hand-and-the-ship-moves-only-the-capability-2026-10-13) named the class: a status kept by hand at a not-done default, whose truth the engine already computes, and which nothing moves at the act that makes it true. understated_status (2026-09-30) only reported the lag, in one roll-up a reader of get_node never saw. The correction works at each of the three places the class showed, without writing anyone's status, since moving one is the owner's word. A reader now gets the computed truth beside the record, one computation shared with the detector so the two cannot disagree. The ship instruction now asks for the edge the promotion detector reads, at the ship rather than only at promotion (47 of 59 ideas the 10-13 judgement pass found built lacked it). And what awaits the owner's word is listed with its evidence, as one additive read the accepted approval page (dec:idea-an-owner-reads-what-they-are-asked-to-approve-in-one-addressed-digest) can build on.

Choices, and why. The field is built_reading because decorate() already adds one computed-on-read fact to every node (discontinued), and reading is the schema's word for a derived meaning. reads_as is derived_report's word for a relation's reading. The values avoid the status words, so the reading cannot be taken for the owner's record or copied into it. The list rides loop_status's scoped answer, not what_next: the scoped answer already lists the other two families an owner is asked for (assigned_decisions, questions_put_to_them), while what_next takes no person and ranks decisions only. Unscoped it is empty, so the call every session makes costs what it did. An item's closing sentence was cut after measuring: 51 items at about 770 bytes each, mostly a 190-byte sentence repeated per item, which is now said once in the scoped next.

Reconciled with the finding's numbers, by id. Components: the finding counted 88 of 107 planned with a built capability or ANY realizing file; the reading counts 87, the extra one being sub:serving, whose only evidence is a file whose own status says nothing (not a build, fact:a-planned-artifact-that-realizes-a-capability-is-counted-as-built-2026-09-28). 89 of all 109 read built or partly built, the 87 plus the 2 already realized. Requirements: the finding's 33 of 82 proposed was taken at c58305ba8; on main 26 of those 82 have since been ruled (9 accepted, 8 dropped, 9 deferred), leaving 56 proposed. 33 of them have a realized or verified satisfying capability, and all 33 are in the list. The list holds 38: the 33 plus 5 delivered through capabilities whose own status lags (req:a-rule-is-recorded-with-its-consequence, req:an-assigned-open-decision-is-reported, req:hosted-state-outlives-the-image, req:pr-is-a-delta, req:the-loop-says-what-is-owed-to-a-person), because delivery is read from the thread (BL-104), not from a status. Ideas: the 13 decision_overtaken_by_promotion reports, the same population.

Not done, by the brief: no requirement, decision or component status moved; closing what reads as built is the owner's word. Whether a later ship follows the new instruction is not measured here.

BOUNDED AFTER REVIEW, 2026-10-14 (433b5ce9b, 8f7551459). Review found the scoped answer over the reply budget. flo2.io's gateway holds every engine reply to 30,000 characters and replaces a larger one with reply_too_large, and it asks a tool for less only when the tool takes budget_chars; loop_status did not. Measured on main's copy, compact: the scoped loop_status was 10,249 on main and 38,939 with awaiting_word. Non-brief scan_nodes of every large type was already 37,645 to 40,110 on main, because its cap was 40,000 characters of nodes alone. Both tools now take budget_chars, default 30,000, counted over the whole reply. loop_status gives in this order (reply_budget::bound_reply_list_first): awaiting_word's prose first, then its rows from the tail, then prose elsewhere. Counts, ids and closing calls stay, and the budget block says what was withheld and how to see the rest. Now: scoped 27,885 with all 51 rows (names and evidence cut); with budget_chars 15,000, 14,658 with 8 of 51 rows shown; unscoped 10,356, unchanged. Full scans of large types are 25,939 to 27,940, paging sooner. replies_are_bounded.py now fires these argument-taking reads too. It had passed while they overflowed, because it only fired tools that take no argument.

properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three additive parts. (1) Every Component carries built_reading on get_node and scan_nodes (brief too), beside its stored status, which is never written: reads_as built / partly_built / not_built, with capabilities_allocated, capabilities_built, files_built and checks_passing counted. One computation, DesignGraph::component_build in arrival.rs, reading the arrival predicate's own built clause (is_built_status, now shared with arrival() and direct_build_evidence) and the direct evidence understated_status already read; understated_status now reads it and its message says how many components read built or partly built; declared as the derived relation built(component), counted by derived_report. (2) The ship step closes the idea it answers: link-artifacts, capture-session, step 3 of the served instructions and AGENTS.md's design-record steps say to draw EVOLVES_INTO from an idea the shipped work answers to the requirement or capability it became and to leave its status for the owner, pinned by skill_lint's ship-step contract. (3) loop_status's owner-scoped answer carries awaiting_word: proposed requirements arrival() reads as Delivered, with what delivers each (requirement_delivered_by, the one delivery derivation, now returning its evidence), and open ideas whose promotion landed (ideas_whose_promotion_landed, the promotion detector's population, factored out). Listed, not attributed, not counted in clean, and no status moved; [] unscoped. Measured on main's copy ea6329305: 61 built, 28 partly built, 20 not built of 109 components (stored statuses unchanged: 107 planned, 2 realized); awaiting_word 51 (38 delivered requirements, 13 promoted ideas); every gap count unchanged.
